sections.text:
1 φλετρὰ cod., φρέατα scripsimus. ὀρύγειν cod., ὀρύσσειν scripsimus (et sic
alias). 1-2 Cf. 34, 14. 2 μεσοφάνεια cod., μεσοφανῆ scripsimus. 3 ἔξη cod.. ἕξει
scripsimus. 6 cod. δημήτριος. 6-8 Cf. 35, 23-25. 9 ἐπόρους cod.; corr. Kroll,
σπόρους ἀπάρχεσθαι = frugum primitias libare, Cumont. 11 κακὸν cod., κακή
scripsimus. 12 cod. φηλόσοφα. 16 Κριανὸς idem ac Κρεῖος, unus ex Titanis?
(Boll). Lege Κρόνος (Kroll). 18 cod. καὶ ante κριοὺς iteratum. 20 cod. θυλυκᾶ.
cod. ἔσονται ἀλλὰ delevimus ἔσονται. 21 ἀληθή cod., ἀληθής scripsimus (et sic
infra). 25 προέρχεσθαι cod.; corr. Kroll. 31 λιτὼν cod., Λητὼ Boll.
sections.en:
1 φλετρὰ ('wells'?) the codex has, φρέατα ('wells') we have written. ὀρύγειν ('to dig') the codex has, ὀρύσσειν ('to dig') we have written (and thus
elsewhere). 1-2 Cf. 34, 14. 2 μεσοφάνεια ('mid-heaven'?) the codex has, μεσοφανῆ ('mid-heaven') we have written. 3 ἔξη ('will have'?) the codex has.. ἕξει ('will have')
we have written. 6 the codex has δημήτριος ('Demetrius'). 6-8 Cf. 35, 23-25. 9 ἐπόρους ('?') the codex has; corrected by Kroll,
σπόρους ἀπάρχεσθαι ('to offer the first fruits of the seeds') = to offer the first fruits of the crops, Cumont. 11 κακὸν ('bad') the codex has, κακή ('bad')
we have written. 12 the codex has φηλόσοφα ('philosophical'). 16 Κριανὸς ('Krianos') the same as Κρεῖος ('Kreios'), one of the Titans?
(Boll). Read Κρόνος ('Kronos') (Kroll). 18 the codex has καὶ ('and') repeated before κριοὺς ('rams'). 20 the codex has θυλυκᾶ ('female').
the codex has ἔσονται ἀλλὰ ('they will be but') we have deleted ἔσονται ('they will be'). 21 ἀληθή ('true') the codex has, ἀληθής ('true') we have written (and thus
below). 25 προέρχεσθαι ('to go forward') the codex has; corrected by Kroll. 31 λιτὼν ('?') the codex has, Λητὼ ('Leto') Boll.

summary.headline: Lunar-Day Prognostications, Days 20–23
summary.text: Astrological lunar-day prognostications for days 20–23, covering ritual, agricultural, travel, legal, medical, dream, fertility, and lost-person omens, with biblical and mythological birth associations.
